name: cache-warmer
description: Prompt-cache indicator plus an opt-in, bounded keepalive (/warm) that keeps an idle Claude Code session's cache warm, so you don't pay to re-cache the whole conversation when you come back.

auto.title: Auto keepalive
auto.description: Keep every interactive session warm for the auto window after each reply (1h-TTL sessions only). Off: arm by hand with /warm.

autoWindowMinutes.title: Auto window (minutes)
autoWindowMinutes.description: How long after the last reply auto keepalive keeps pinging (max 480).

indicator.title: Cache indicator
indicator.description: Show cache state (warm/cold, time left, hit ratio) under the prompt.
